raw_source.title: [Remote] Kongregate is Hiring Blockchain Frontend Team Lead
raw_source.body:
🎮 Frontend Team Lead — Blockchain Gaming
Kongregate | San Francisco, CA | Remote

Kongregate(https://kongregate.com) is looking for an experienced Frontend Team Lead to lead frontend development for modern gaming and Web3 products.

Responsibilities:
- Lead and mentor frontend developers
- Own frontend architecture and technical direction
- Build high-performance gaming/Web3 interfaces
- ntegrate APIs, wallets, and blockchain functionality
- Conduct code reviews and maintain engineering standards
- Collaborate with backend, blockchain, and product teams

Requirements:
- Strong React, TypeScript, and JavaScript experience
- Frontend architecture and team leadership experience
- Web3/blockchain and wallet integration experience
- Strong problem-solving and communication skills

Engagement: Contract / Remote

Apply or message us to discuss the opportunity.

Telegram: @samuelschmidtx
raw_source.author: maxmmurphys
